title: feat(mindiff): first |S|<=3 seed where f_min and f_L1 disagree
science: One of the strongest in the batch, and it silently CORRECTS the series' own account of f_min vs f_L1. Exhaustive lex census of all 298 nonempty seeds with |S|<=3 on the two-cube: every 1-site seed and the long-axis 3-site seed agree, and the FIRST separating seed is the opposite-corner pair S={(0,0,0),(2,1,1)} - f_L1 fills with (2,8,12) T=2, f_min halts at 10 with (2,8,10) and does not fill.
